name: muni-mobile
comment:typescript-pin: SDK 57 expects typescript ~6.0.3, but react-i18next@15 declares an optional peer of typescript ^5 and npm refuses to resolve the tree with TS 6 installed — any later `npm install <pkg>` fails with ERESOLVE. Only react-i18next@17 widens that peer, and bumping the i18n library two majors to satisfy a dev-only compiler is the wrong trade. TS 5.9 still satisfies @expo/require-utils' ^5 || ^6 || ^7 peer and typechecks the SDK 57 types cleanly. Drop this exclude and move to TS 6 when react-i18next is upgraded.
comment:jest-expo-modules-core: jest-expo's preset/setup.js does a bare require('expo-modules-core') without declaring it — its own source calls this an invalid dependency chain. npm will not hoist expo-modules-core to the top level because it peer-depends on react-native-worklets, which this app does not install, so it stays nested under expo/node_modules where Jest's resolver never looks. Without these two entries every suite fails to run. Remove them if expo-modules-core ever hoists (check: node_modules/expo-modules-core exists).
comment:workspaces: mobile is deliberately NOT a member of the root npm workspaces. Hoisting react-native/expo into a root node_modules shared with the 35 backend services breaks Metro's single-copy-of-react invariant and its haste map. Install it standalone: cd mobile && npm install.
